question: Can one compact generic continuous-predicate qualification responsibility repair demonstrated sampled-persistence gaps, preserve qualified protocols, and survive a subsequently selected frozen unseen workload?
responsibility: TEMPORAL_QUALIFY: qualify T consecutive synchronized observations of a configured RX level or constant-true predicate; register success, restart in place or branch on an interrupted partial qualification.

encoding.reserved: argument[7:2], value[15:1] and flags[9:4]/flags[1:0] must be zero; constant-true delay requires value==0 and branch flag==0
encoding.compatibility: Previously qualified v2 profiles remain unchanged. Accepted v2 binary tables using formerly ignored temporal-tag bits acquire v3 meaning; arbitrary ignored-bit compatibility is not claimed.

timing_contract: Actors consume existing synchronized frontend observations; unsampled analog/subcycle pulses are outside the claim.
T matching observations qualify. The first matching observation counts as one; T=1 qualifies on that observation.
When entry zero is temporal, acquisition counts its matching observation after clearing the old epoch. Acquisition suppresses ordinary actions/output responses.
A newly entered temporal entry through an allowed chain can count that cycle's observation.
Temporal state advances at most once per core cycle. A second temporal entry reached by chaining is deferred until the next cycle.
A false observation on the would-be T-th observation prevents qualification. False before qualification resets count immediately.
Initially false predicates wait without interruption branching. Restart waits in place for a fresh matching interval; branch mode takes alternate when a started partial qualification is interrupted.
Success is registered on the T-th matching observation and consumed on the following executor cycle. A false observation after registered success does not revoke it.
Completion consumption and interruption branching clear temporal state before leaving the entry.
Reset/disable/abort/release/watchdog/fatal condition clears stale temporal progress/completion before normal execution. Fresh acquisition clears the old epoch and may seed entry zero.
Keep four distinct immediate entries maximum, existing guardian output suppression and pre-edge FIFO/readiness decisions.
permitted_changes: One tagged WAIT temporal family with one separate 16-bit qualification counter and minimal lifecycle state.
Matching model/RTL/host validation, public packing helpers, configuration, independent tests and instrumentation.
Existing model correspondence correction: WAIT compares the pre-edge TX bit, matching existing RTL and preregistered pre-edge predicate responsibility.
Existing model correspondence correction: terminating HALT cancels same-cycle FIFO operations, matching the original RTL. Record the original counterexample and exact cancellation contract.
Historical snapshot dispatch so original frozen v2 sources and evidence continue to be verified unchanged.
Synthesis/accounting/manifest improvements, reproducible diagrams/demos and documentation without protocol-specific generic RTL.
prohibited_changes: Protocol-name branches, dedicated protocol FSMs/counters/wrappers, hardcoded reset/presence constants or assumptions tied to DQ in generic RTL.
Shared timed-sampling, existing WAIT, frontend, guardian or watchdog semantic redesign.
Additional predicate families, duration upper bounds, opcode widening, table growth or configuration storage growth.
Changing historical workload/oracle/results/manifests to accommodate new evidence.
Researching/selecting the unseen workload before v3 freeze, or semantic repair/candidate switching after its selection.

budgets.mapping_comparison: Same pinned Yosys/ABC, CMOS5L typical library and top; remap frozen v2 and v3, retain library/tool/source identities.

success_criteria.temporal: Independent exhaustive small-threshold expectations and model/RTL comparison; both levels, delay, below/equal/above, interruptions before/on/after completion, threshold1/65535, acquisition/chaining, lifecycle and back-to-back cases.
success_criteria.training: All nine original unchanged 1-Wire wire-level stimuli/oracles pass; no presence after LOW200us/HIGH1us/LOW300us. Added startup interruption, restarted valid low, 590us legal reset and deterministic legal reset/release-phase sweeps pass.
success_criteria.regression: Original48 I2C cases with identical stimuli and legacy externally visible equivalence; exact Microwire A55A including runtime back-to-back; SPI/UART/timed stream/FIFO/host/guardian/watchdog, lint, existing formal/bounded checks and cocotb runtime tests all pass.
success_criteria.freeze: Clean committed sources, complete fresh logical/synthesis/accounting evidence, within budgets, immutable manifest/source/model/compiler/harness/tool/test/oracle/report hashes before future workload research.
success_criteria.unseen: One new timing-sensitive workload selected and committed after freeze; independently preregistered wire oracle passes with configuration only and unchanged semantic manifest.
success_criteria.physical: Only after unseen logical pass, pinned official6x4/20ns flow, precheck and routed functional/source-correspondence checks; capture metrics honestly.
success_criteria.demonstration: Real protocol waveforms and execution traces linked to architecture/netlist views, and physical views only if identified artifacts exist; reproducible CLI/HTML/public guides.

future_unseen_rule.selection: After freeze only: primary-source candidate matrix, exclude electrically unobservable/no accessible timing/no independent bounded oracle; rank structural independence then temporal falsification value then smaller bounded scope, finally workload-name ordering.

stop_conditions: Repair requires protocol-specific RTL or a second architectural responsibility.
A previously qualified workload regresses and no simple generic correction within this contract resolves it.
Added state/configuration or mapped area exceeds the fixed budget; do not optimize to evade the measured result.
Frozen unseen workload requires any semantic architecture repair; retain negative result, no candidate substitution.
Physical closure fails after initial run plus at most two diagnosed flow-setting revisions at6x4/20ns, or evidence establishes impracticality.
reporting: Keep historical negative evidence, distinguish facts/measurements/interpretation/hypotheses; report logical, cost and physical classifications separately. Complete reached demonstrations and requested A-Z final report even after a stop.
